Well structured: credibility opener, then access (single gate, wheelbarrow), spoils, gravel and permit questions, a clear spec (3,000 psi, rebar 36 in. OC) and a firm $3,200 price including a rush fee to beat his fence deadline. Missed: never asked budget before pricing, so the rush fee pushed it past what he expected and he pivoted to a wood deck; no value contrast beyond 'concrete lasts'. He passed by text an hour later. Next time: ask the budget first and offer a no-rush price next to the rush option.

Missed: long call with connection trouble, no budget or decision-timeline question, and no urgency or reason to choose us over the other bidder. She cancelled Wednesday's visit and hired someone else that afternoon.
